metrics.name: Gross Merchandise Value (GMV)
metrics.description: Total value of all successful service bookings in INR.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT SUM(booking_value) AS value FROM bookings WHERE payment_status = 'success'
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT booking_date AS date, SUM(booking_value) AS value FROM bookings WHERE payment_status = 'success' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: Net Revenue
metrics.description: Total commission earned by the platform from successful bookings.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT SUM(commission_earned) AS value FROM bookings_economics WHERE payment_status = 'success'
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT booking_date AS date, SUM(commission_earned) AS value FROM bookings_economics WHERE payment_status = 'success' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: Booking Completion Rate
metrics.description: Ratio of completed bookings to total bookings requested.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT completion_rate AS value FROM weekly_company_kpis ORDER BY week_start DESC LIMIT 1
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT week_start AS date, completion_rate AS value FROM weekly_company_kpis ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Contribution Margin %
metrics.description: Profitability per booking after all variable costs and discounts.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT AVG(contribution_margin_pct) AS value FROM bookings_economics WHERE payment_status = 'success'
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT booking_date AS date, AVG(contribution_margin_pct) AS value FROM bookings_economics WHERE payment_status = 'success' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: Blended CAC
metrics.description: Total marketing spend (Ads + Comms + Referrals) divided by new customers.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT blended_cac AS value FROM weekly_company_kpis ORDER BY week_start DESC LIMIT 1
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT week_start AS date, blended_cac AS value FROM weekly_company_kpis ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Net Promoter Score (NPS)
metrics.description: Measure of customer loyalty based on survey scores (0-10).
metrics.valueSql: SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN score >= 9 THEN 1 WHEN score <= 6 THEN -1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS value FROM survey_full WHERE survey_type = 'nps'
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(submitted_at AS DATE) AS date, (SUM(CASE WHEN score >= 9 THEN 1 WHEN score <= 6 THEN -1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS value FROM survey_full WHERE survey_type = 'nps' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: On-Time Arrival Rate
metrics.description: Percentage of bookings where the partner arrived within the SLA target.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT on_time_pct AS value FROM weekly_company_kpis ORDER BY week_start DESC LIMIT 1
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT week_start AS date, on_time_pct AS value FROM weekly_company_kpis ORDER BY date
metrics.formula: COUNT(CASE WHEN on_time THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*)

metrics.name: Monthly Active Users (MAU)
metrics.description: Number of unique customers who had at least one app session in the last 30 days.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS value FROM daily_sessions WHERE session_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days'
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', session_date) AS date, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS value FROM daily_sessions GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: LTV:CAC Ratio (30-Day)
metrics.description: Ratio of the average 30-day LTV to the Blended CAC.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT ltv_cac_ratio AS value FROM monthly_company_kpis ORDER BY month DESC LIMIT 1
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT month AS date, ltv_cac_ratio AS value FROM monthly_company_kpis ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Activation Rate
metrics.description: Percentage of signups that complete their first booking.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT activation_rate_pct AS value FROM activation_metrics ORDER BY month DESC LIMIT 1
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT month AS date, activation_rate_pct AS value FROM activation_metrics ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Average Arrival Time
metrics.description: Average time in minutes taken by partners to arrive at the customer location.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT avg_arrival_min AS value FROM weekly_company_kpis ORDER BY week_start DESC LIMIT 1
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT week_start AS date, avg_arrival_min AS value FROM weekly_company_kpis ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Ad Spend ROAS
metrics.description: Return on Ad Spend calculated as GMV from first bookings divided by ad spend.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(roas * spend_inr) / NULLIF(SUM(spend_inr), 0), 2) AS value FROM ad_full
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT date, roas AS value FROM ad_full ORDER BY date

metrics.name: CRM Conversion Rate
metrics.description: Percentage of sent CRM messages that resulted in a booking within 24 hours.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN converted THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS value FROM comms_full WHERE delivered = true
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(sent_at AS DATE) AS date, SUM(CASE WHEN converted THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS value FROM comms_full WHERE delivered = true GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: Average Partner Rating
metrics.description: Mean rating given to partners by customers after bookings.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT avg_partner_rating AS value FROM weekly_company_kpis ORDER BY week_start DESC LIMIT 1
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT week_start AS date, avg_partner_rating AS value FROM weekly_company_kpis ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Partner Churn Rate
metrics.description: Percentage of partners who had zero shifts this month compared to the previous month.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT partner_churn_rate AS value FROM monthly_company_kpis ORDER BY month DESC LIMIT 1
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT month AS date, partner_churn_rate AS value FROM monthly_company_kpis ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Average Booking Value (ABV)
metrics.description: The average INR value of a successful booking.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT gmv / NULLIF(total_bookings, 0) AS value FROM weekly_company_kpis ORDER BY week_start DESC LIMIT 1
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT week_start AS date, (gmv / total_bookings) AS value FROM weekly_company_kpis ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Referral K-Factor
metrics.description: Average number of new signups generated by each active referrer.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT referral_k_factor AS value FROM monthly_company_kpis ORDER BY month DESC LIMIT 1
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT month AS date, referral_k_factor AS value FROM monthly_company_kpis ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Push/Email Open Rate
metrics.description: Ratio of opened messages to delivered messages (excluding SMS).
metrics.valueSql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN opened THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS value FROM comms_full WHERE delivered = true AND channel IN ('push', 'email')
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(sent_at AS DATE) AS date, SUM(CASE WHEN opened THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS value FROM comms_full WHERE delivered = true AND channel IN ('push', 'email') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: Sessions Per User
metrics.description: Average number of app sessions per user in a day.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT AVG(session_count) AS value FROM daily_sessions
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT session_date AS date, AVG(session_count) AS value FROM daily_sessions GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: Signup to Book Days
metrics.description: Average number of days from user signup to their first booking.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT signup_to_book_days_avg AS value FROM monthly_company_kpis ORDER BY month DESC LIMIT 1
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT month AS date, signup_to_book_days_avg AS value FROM monthly_company_kpis ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Total Partner Payout
metrics.description: Total net earnings paid out to partners including incentives and minus penalties.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT SUM(net_payout) AS value FROM partner_payouts WHERE payout_status = 'processed'
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT payout_week_start AS date, SUM(net_payout) AS value FROM partner_payouts WHERE payout_status = 'processed' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: Promo Discount Burn
metrics.description: Total value of platform-funded discounts given to customers.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT SUM(promo_discount_funded) AS value FROM bookings_economics WHERE payment_status = 'success'
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT booking_date AS date, SUM(promo_discount_funded) AS value FROM bookings_economics WHERE payment_status = 'success' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: Platform Take Rate
metrics.description: Revenue as a percentage of GMV.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT take_rate AS value FROM weekly_company_kpis ORDER BY week_start DESC LIMIT 1
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT week_start AS date, take_rate AS value FROM weekly_company_kpis ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Signup to Profile %
metrics.description: Conversion rate from signup complete to profile completion.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT conversion_rate_pct AS value FROM funnel_conversion_metrics WHERE stage = 'profile_done' ORDER BY month DESC LIMIT 1
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT month AS date, conversion_rate_pct AS value FROM funnel_conversion_metrics WHERE stage = 'profile_done' ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Average CSAT
metrics.description: Customer Satisfaction score averaged from post-booking surveys (1-5 scale).
metrics.valueSql: SELECT csat_avg AS value FROM weekly_company_kpis ORDER BY week_start DESC LIMIT 1
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT week_start AS date, csat_avg AS value FROM weekly_company_kpis ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Total Incentives Paid
metrics.description: Bonus amounts earned by partners for performance or shift completion.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT total_incentives AS value FROM monthly_partner_economics ORDER BY month DESC LIMIT 1
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT month AS date, total_incentives AS value FROM monthly_partner_economics ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Customer Repeat Rate
metrics.description: Percentage of unique customers in a week who have booked before.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT repeat_rate AS value FROM weekly_company_kpis ORDER BY week_start DESC LIMIT 1
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT week_start AS date, repeat_rate AS value FROM weekly_company_kpis ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Gross Burn
metrics.description: Total spend across ads, CRM communications, and referral rewards.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT gross_burn AS value FROM weekly_company_kpis ORDER BY week_start DESC LIMIT 1
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT week_start AS date, gross_burn AS value FROM weekly_company_kpis ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Total App Installs
metrics.description: Count of unique app installs from paid and organic sources.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT SUM(installs) AS value FROM ad_platform_metrics
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT month AS date, SUM(installs) AS value FROM ad_platform_metrics GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: Active Partner Count
metrics.description: Number of unique partners who completed at least one shift in the period.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT active_partners AS value FROM weekly_company_kpis ORDER BY week_start DESC LIMIT 1
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT week_start AS date, active_partners AS value FROM weekly_company_kpis ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Average Booking Value
metrics.description: The average booking value across all successful bookings, excluding failed or refunded transactions.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT AVG(booking_value) AS value FROM bookings WHERE payment_status = 'success'
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT booking_date AS date, AVG(booking_value) AS value FROM bookings WHERE payment_status = 'success' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: Partner Shift Completion Rate
metrics.description: The percentage of total partner shifts that reached 'served' status.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT (COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'served' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS value FROM partner_shifts
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT shift_date AS date, (COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'served' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS value FROM partner_shifts GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: CRM Open Rate
metrics.description: The percentage of total communications sent that were opened by the recipient.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT (COUNT(CASE WHEN opened = true THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS value FROM comms_full
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(sent_at AS DATE) AS date, (COUNT(CASE WHEN opened = true THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS value FROM comms_full GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
metrics.formula: (COUNT(CASE WHEN opened = true THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*)) * 100

metrics.name: Booking Cancellation Rate
metrics.description: Percentage of total bookings marked as inactive.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT (COUNT(CASE WHEN is_active = false THEN 1 END) * 100.0) / COUNT(*) AS value FROM bookings
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT booking_date AS date, (COUNT(CASE WHEN is_active = false THEN 1 END) * 100.0) / COUNT(*) AS value FROM bookings GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: Booking Cancellation Rate
metrics.description: Refunded bookings percentage for orders exceeding 500 value.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT (COUNT(CASE WHEN payment_status = 'refunded' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS value FROM bookings WHERE booking_value > 500
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT booking_date AS date, (COUNT(CASE WHEN payment_status = 'refunded' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS value FROM bookings WHERE booking_value > 500 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
metrics.formula: (COUNT(CASE WHEN payment_status = 'refunded' AND booking_value > 500 THEN 1 END) / COUNT(CASE WHEN booking_value > 500 THEN 1 END)) * 100.0

metrics.name: CRM Push Open Rate
metrics.description: Percentage of delivered CRM push notifications that were opened
metrics.valueSql: SELECT (COUNT(CASE WHEN opened = true THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN delivered = true THEN 1 END), 0)) AS value FROM comms_full WHERE channel = 'push'
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(sent_at AS DATE) AS date, (COUNT(CASE WHEN opened = true THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN delivered = true THEN 1 END), 0)) AS value FROM comms_full WHERE channel = 'push' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: Return on Ad Spend
metrics.description: Revenue generated for every rupee spent on advertising.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT date AS date, SUM(roas * spend_inr) / NULLIF(SUM(spend_inr), 0) AS value FROM ad_full GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT date AS date, SUM(roas * spend_inr) / NULLIF(SUM(spend_inr), 0) AS value FROM ad_full GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: Partner Shift Completion Rate
metrics.description: Percentage of shifts served excluding null status records.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT (COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'served' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(status)) AS value FROM partner_shifts
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT shift_date AS date, (COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'served' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(status)) AS value FROM partner_shifts GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: GMV excluding Sarjapur Hub
metrics.description: Total revenue across all hubs excluding Sarjapur Hub.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT SUM(revenue) AS value FROM hub_metrics WHERE hub_name != 'Sarjapur Hub'
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CURRENT_DATE AS date, SUM(revenue) AS value FROM hub_metrics WHERE hub_name != 'Sarjapur Hub' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: Daily Booking Count
metrics.description: Total number of service bookings created each day.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT COUNT(booking_id) AS value FROM bookings
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT booking_date AS date, COUNT(booking_id) AS value FROM bookings GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
